actual_observations.macro: Dark hair does not form a uniform helmet; continuous crown arcs and large paper voids separate tuft silhouettes.
actual_observations.meso: Left and right hair groups follow differing scalp tangents; curved white paper channels reveal crown flow and temple transitions.
actual_observations.micro: Individual fine etched locks vary in length and spacing; thick dark shadows and hairline incisions have hierarchy, not random parallel scratches.

actual_observations.micro: Tapered curved strokes have unequal lengths, break at turning points, and leave clean unprinted gaps.
